profiles.finding: Historian quotes Mauch Chunk Democrat September23,1876: Fisher and McKenna arrested together and both now in Pottsville jail; December16 trial testimony says Linden sent arrest warrants but did not personally arrest them. This establishes custody by September23, not a specific admission day/month. Original September23 scan not obtained. Do not use newspaper publication as admission. Secondary assertion Fisher not arrested in August needs original corroboration before narrowing to September.

profiles.result: Initial custody and conflicting offense summaries unresolved
